test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having colours. Red, Blue, Pink, Green, White and black. Find the colour on the face opposite to the face showing 'Red'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79ab8d95670717c534d3f8495acab09e3256e5fc933a40f871b881d77aa8fb06.png]
solution:
As per the shown faces of the dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ea1fbde8193b6e2570a9ae424ec89809abb72c81725844bec38b4f7453e70df.png] 

There Pink and Blue faces are common, which means Red is the opposite face of White.

Here, **White** is the opposite face of Red.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
